title: Split briefs.rs: move boundary-scan code into a submodule
summary: Restructure crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs, the audience being code health, so production lines fall under 1500. Move the boundary-word scan and plain-text rewrite group (boundary_words through plain_boundary_text, about 270 lines) into a new briefs/boundary.rs submodule, re-exported so public paths stay unchanged. No behavior change.

defaults_applied.how: One focused move of a single cohesive group.
cargo test, clippy and fmt required.
Splits by responsibility rather than trimming lines to scrape under the limit.
Verifier runs cargo test, clippy and fmt --check.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs (item outline) and crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs; briefs is declared `pub mod briefs;` in lib.rs, and the file has a `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` at line 2545 that reaches items through `super::*`. No record or data file is added, so check_record_file and AnyRecord are not involved.

Existing code: boundary_words, boundary_fragments, banned_words_section, BoundaryHit, boundary_scan, plain_alternatives, replace_boundary_words and plain_boundary_text form a cohesive group (lines ~828-1100) that is cut out as a unit; callers elsewhere in the workspace keep using athena_context::briefs::<name> through `pub use`.
Moved items that tests or sibling code use privately become pub(super) or pub(crate); public API paths stay identical.
Measured by code health as production lines excluding test modules; the target is under 1500, so move at least about 60 lines, with a margin.
No refusal rule is added or tightened, so no refusal-rate criterion applies.
Governance files (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows) need no change.

acceptance_criteria.text: crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs has fewer than 1500 production lines (test module excluded), checkable by counting lines before `#[cfg(test)]` in the file; a new file crates/athena-context/src/briefs/boundary.rs holds the moved boundary-scan code and briefs.rs declares `mod boundary;` with a `pub use` of its public items.

The diff only moves code: no function body in the moved items changes, and the public names (boundary_words, boundary_fragments, boundary_scan, plain_boundary_text, BoundaryHit, and the instruction constants) remain reachable at athena_context::briefs::.
Run `cargo test --workspace`: all existing tests pass unchanged, including the briefs tests and dependents that import athena_context::briefs items.
Run `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` with no warnings, and `cargo fmt --check` passes.
No test is deleted or weakened; the diff to the briefs test module is limited to import adjustments, if any.

out_of_scope: Any behavior change to brief text or boundary scanning
Splitting other files or changing athena.toml limits
Changes to lib.rs unless a module declaration proves necessary
